title: PostgreSQL security-restricted operations can create types in pg_temp, which later queries of the session find…
description: A vulnerability in PostgreSQL allows security-restricted operations to create types in the temporary schema (pg_temp) that can later be used by the session to execute arbitrary SQL as the operation's caller. This issue affects versions prior to 14.25, 15.20, 16.16, 17.12, and 18.7. The vulnerability requires that the victim session runs a query with an unqualified type name, which is not common in autovacuum or similar operations.
